QUANTDINGER_FRONTEND_IMAGE.description: Web UI image (build argument), pinned to QuantDinger 5.8.4 by digest. Keep it on the same release as QUANTDINGER_BACKEND_IMAGE on Backend.

PORT.description: Port nginx listens on (public domain target and healthcheck).

BACKEND_URL.description: Backend API on the private network; nginx proxies /api/ to it and re-resolves the name every 10 s.

NGINX_RESOLVER.description: Optional DNS server for nginx. Empty = the container's resolver from /etc/resolv.conf (Railway private DNS).

NGINX_TRUST_FORWARDED_FOR.description: Take the visitor IP from X-Forwarded-For sent by Railway's proxy (private addresses only), so login rate limits see real client IPs.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploy.

QUANTDINGER_BACKEND_IMAGE.description: Backend image every backend-image service is built from (build argument). Pinned to QuantDinger v5.8.4 by digest; change it here to upgrade, then redeploy Backend and all workers.

TZ.description: Time zone of all backend processes and Celery schedules (upstream's compose default is Asia/Shanghai).

SECRET_KEY.description: JWT/session signing key, generated at deploy and shared by every backend process. Changing it signs everyone out.

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts saved exchange/broker credentials and MFA secrets, generated at deploy. Never change it after saving credentials (they become unreadable).

ADMIN_USER.description: Username of the first administrator, created on the first start (3-50 letters, digits or underscores).

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first administrator, generated at deploy. Used once to create the account; change your password in the app afterwards.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Optional email of the first administrator (password recovery, notifications).

ENABLE_REGISTRATION.description: Public sign-up. Off: only the administrator can create users. Sign-up also needs SMTP for verification codes.

LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED.description: Allows strategies in live execution mode (real orders). Off by default; paper/signal mode only. Manual Quick Trade orders are NOT covered by this switch.

AGENT_LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED.description: Allows live orders from Agent Tokens (MCP and the agent API). Off by default (paper orders only).

BROKER_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED.description: Shows exchange/broker account settings in the UI (upstream default). Nothing trades until you save exchange API keys yourself.

AGENT_GATEWAY_ENABLED.description: Agent Gateway /api/agent/v1 (needed by the MCP Server).

USDT_PAY_ENABLED.description: USDT on-chain payment module (upstream default off).

USDC_PAY_ENABLED.description: USDC on-chain payment module (upstream default off).

QUANTDINGER_DEPLOYMENT_MODE.description: Deployment mode (self_hosted, or saas for a multi-tenant service).

OPENAPI_ENABLED.description: Interactive API docs at /api/docs (off in production upstream).

PYTHON_API_DEBUG.description: Flask debug mode (never enable on a public instance).

SKIP_AUTO_MIGRATE.description: Processes do not migrate on start; Backend's pre-deploy command runs the migration.

CELERY_TASKS_ENABLED.description: Run AI jobs, backtests and maintenance through Celery (Redis Jobs).

CELERY_BROKER_DB.description: Redis Jobs database of the Celery broker.

CELERY_RESULT_DB.description: Redis Jobs database of the Celery results.

KAFKA_EVENT_PUBLISH_ENABLED.description: Publish bar-close, strategy and order events to Kafka.

KAFKA_MARKET_PARTITIONS.description: Partitions of the market-bar topic (set before the first deploy; not changed later).

MARKET_CATALOG_AUTO_SYNC.description: Sync the market symbol catalog automatically.

MARKET_CATALOG_SYNC_INTERVAL_SEC.description: Market catalog sync interval in seconds.

LLM_PROVIDER.description: AI provider: openrouter, openai, google, deepseek, grok, minimax, atlascloud or custom (any OpenAI-compatible API). Optional: the app runs without AI keys.

CUSTOM_API_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible API, ending in /v1 (LLM_PROVIDER=custom).

TAVILY_API_KEYS.description: Optional. Tavily key(s) for AI web/news search (comma-separated).

FINNHUB_API_KEY.description: Optional. Finnhub key (US stock quotes, profiles, news).

TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY.description: Optional. Twelve Data key (CN/HK stock candles from overseas servers).

QD_SCHEMA_WAIT_SECONDS.description: Template wrapper: how long workers wait for Backend's migration before starting anyway.

QD_THREAD_CAP.description: Template wrapper: upper limit for native thread pools (numpy/BLAS), also capped by the service's CPU quota.

CELERY_REDIS_HOST.description: Durable job Redis host (Celery broker and results).

FRONTEND_URL.description: Public web origin (CORS, OAuth redirects). Change it when you add a custom domain to Web.

QD_PROCESS_ROLE.description: Process role (the start command enforces it).

STRATEGY_COMMANDS_ENABLED.description: Accepts strategy start/stop commands (API process only).

DB_POOL_MAX.description: Connection pool limit of this process (keep the sum of all pools below Postgres max_connections=200).

PORT.description: Port Railway health-checks (gunicorn listens on [::]:5000). Never add a public domain: Web proxies /api.

PYTHON_API_HOST.description: Bind address of gunicorn (dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 for the private network).

PYTHON_API_PORT.description: Port of the API (Web proxies to it).

QUANTDINGER_ENV_FILE.description: Settings file on the Backend volume (the Settings page writes here). Railway variables are written into it at every start.

PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR.description: Prometheus multiprocess metrics directory (cleared on start).

GUNICORN_MAX_REQUESTS.description: Requests before a gunicorn worker is recycled.

GUNICORN_MAX_REQUESTS_JITTER.description: Random jitter for the recycling above.

DB_POOL_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds to wait for a free database connection.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploy (graceful worker shutdown, as upstream's stop_grace_period).

CELERY_REDIS_HOST.description: Durable job Redis host (Celery broker and results).

FRONTEND_URL.description: Public web origin (CORS, OAuth redirects). Change it when you add a custom domain to Web.

QD_PROCESS_ROLE.description: Process role (the start command enforces it).

STRATEGY_COMMANDS_ENABLED.description: Accepts strategy start/stop commands (API process only).

DB_POOL_MAX.description: Connection pool limit of this process (keep the sum of all pools below Postgres max_connections=200).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploy (graceful worker shutdown, as upstream's stop_grace_period).

QUANTDINGER_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Agent Token (qd_agent_...) the MCP server acts with. Empty until you issue one: QuantDinger -> Profile -> My Agent Token (paper-only recommended). Until then the endpoint answers 503.

QUANTDINGER_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token MCP clients must send (Authorization: Bearer ...), generated at deploy. Keep it secret.

QUANTDINGER_BASE_URL.description: QuantDinger API on the private network.

QUANTDINGER_MCP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public https origin of this service (change it when you add a custom domain).

QUANTDINGER_MCP_HOST.description: Bind address (IPv4; Railway's proxy and healthcheck connect over IPv4).

QUANTDINGER_TIMEOUT_S.description: Timeout for calls to the QuantDinger API, in seconds.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploy.

PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the volume (Railway base layout).

PGUSER.description: User for the Data panel and the other services.

PGPASSWORD.description: Password for the Data panel and the other services.

PGDATABASE.description: Database for the Data panel and the other services.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Superuser password, generated at deploy (letters only, safe in URLs).

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on first boot (QuantDinger's tables live here).

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed TLS certificate.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Postgres gets to shut down cleanly on redeploy.

REDIS_MAXMEMORY.description: Memory cap of the cache; least recently used keys are evicted (upstream: 128mb, allkeys-lru, no persistence).

Redis Jobs.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "rm -rf $RAILWAY_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH/lost+found/ && exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --requirepass $REDIS_PASSWORD --dir $RAILWAY_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH --appendonly yes --appendfsync everysec --save 60 1000 --maxmemory $REDIS_MAXMEMORY --maxmemory-policy noeviction"

REDIS_MAXMEMORY.description: Memory cap of the job queue. noeviction: when full, new jobs are refused instead of silently dropping queued ones (upstream: 512mb, AOF everysec).

KAFKA_LISTENERS.description: Listeners on all IPv6 and IPv4 addresses (librdkafka clients try IPv6 first).

KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS.description: Address clients are told to use (private network only).

KAFKA_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS.description: Controller quorum. localhost on purpose: a service cannot resolve its own private name while it boots.

KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS.description: Partitions of auto-created topics (upstream compose value).

KAFKA_LOG_DIRS.description: Data directory inside the volume (a subdirectory, so the volume's lost+found is not taken for a partition).

CLUSTER_ID.description: KRaft cluster id used to format the volume on first boot (upstream compose value; not a secret). Do not change it after the first deploy.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Run as root so Kafka can write to the volume (mounted root-owned).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Kafka gets to shut down cleanly on redeploy.
